<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 194.0862, which corresponds to the protonated molecular ion [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈ 193.0789 Da. The isotopic pattern (≈ 13 % M+1) indicates about 11 carbon atoms. The formula that matches this exact mass most closely is C₁₁H₁₃O₃ (exact mass 193.0865 Da), within typical high‑resolution error limits. Therefore the molecular formula is C11H13O3.</thought>
<final_answer>C11H13O3</final_answer>
